review_type: Independent semantic review of another translator's complete draft
source: source/pages.json; original ArmourAstir_af_illus.pdf for p2 and p12 layout verification
method: Read every source paragraph and matching Chinese page in full in seven sequential batches, then visually checked original PDF p2 and p12 to resolve extraction order. Compared stated mechanics, numerical values, modal permissions, examples, scene options, lists and tables directly; no inference of omissions from text length. No source or translation files were modified by reviewer.
review_snapshot: Findings describe the draft as read before parent fixes. Parent was notified and will record resolutions separately. This report deliberately remains pass=false until those resolutions are verified by parent.

findings.source_excerpt: otherwise, bite the dust in desperation until the end of the Sortie. Further dangers just trigger bite the dust instead.
findings.draft_excerpt: 否則擲「倒下」，並在出擊結束前身處絕境。之後再獲得危難，直接觸發「倒下」。
findings.problem: 原文把直到出擊結束的絕境狀態限定在 bite the dust 擲骰。譯文將『擲倒下』與『在出擊結束前身處絕境』分開，容易把懲罰擴張為之後所有動作皆處於絕境，改變超額危難的效果範圍。
findings.required_change: 明定直到本次出擊結束，進行『倒下』時都在絕境中擲骰，例如『否則直到本次出擊結束，你擲「倒下」時都要在絕境中行動。之後的危難改為直接觸發「倒下」。』不要把絕境套到所有動作。

findings.source_location: p012, five illustrated example GRAVITY clocks; verified on original PDF
findings.source_excerpt: Original graphic left to right: Nervous friends +1; Fated lovers +3; Zealous rivals +1; Chasing the same boy +2; Estranged siblings +2.
findings.draft_excerpt: 圖例關係：緊張的朋友（+1）、疏遠的手足（+3）、追求同一個男孩（+1）、命定戀人（+2）、熱切的宿敵（+2）。
findings.problem: PDF 抽字次序將數值與圖例名稱打散，譯稿因此錯配四組名稱與數值。這不是原書數值矛盾；圖上配對清楚可辨。
findings.required_change: 依原圖改成『緊張的朋友（+1）、命定戀人（+3）、熱切的宿敵（+1）、追求同一個男孩（+2）、疏遠的手足（+2）』。

findings.source_location: p022, READ THE ROOM failure result
findings.source_excerpt: On a failure, you may ask one of the above questions immediately, but the answer creates a problem or puts you in danger.
findings.draft_excerpt: 失敗：立即問上面一題，但答案會製造問題或使你陷入危險。
findings.problem: 原文 may ask 是玩家可選擇提問；譯文省略『可』，讀起來像失敗後必須提問。p019 摘要則已正確寫『可立即問』。
findings.required_change: 改為『失敗：可立即問上面一題，但答案會製造問題或使你陷入危險。』與摘要一致。
